summary: A local donor gives every cycle out of habit or loyalty and says they expect nothing for it.
realLife: A radio commentary on local giving says many donors give the same amount each cycle out of habit, social pressure and party loyalty, and most expect nothing in return, though regular givers may get more notice.
sources: WHQR, Sunday Edition: Give 'Till It Hurts, Aug. 23, 2026: https://www.whqr.org/local/2026-08-23/sunday-edition-give-till-it-hurts
inGame: campaign contribution records by donor over cycles
